title: Buyer Road Map: What Happens After You Go Under Contract? | Twins Realty
description:
Buying a home doesn’t stop once your offer is accepted — in many ways, that’s when the real process begins.

After going under contract, buyers enter a critical stage where lenders, underwriters, inspections, and documentation all come into play. Small financial changes or unexpected decisions during this time can raise questions and potentially delay closing.

In this episode, we walk through the buyer road map and explain what buyers should expect after going under contract.

If you're buying in Killeen, Temple, Belton, or surrounding Central Texas areas, understanding this stage of the process can help your transaction move smoothly.

In this episode:
• What happens after your offer is accepted
• How underwriting reviews your financial documents
• Why buyers should avoid big financial changes during this stage
• How to keep the closing process on track

The fewer unexpected changes during this stage, the smoother your home purchase will be.

📍 Serving buyers and sellers across Central Texas.
